description:
Patches that restore Reddit galleries, load more comments, Redgifs and imgur albums/metadata in **Sync for Reddit v23.06.30-13:39** (free, Pro and dev).

Add this as a remote patch bundle in ReVanced Manager:
`https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bstamper4/revanced-sync-fixes/main/bundles/stable.json`

Patches: Fix Reddit galleries, Fix load more comments, Fix Redgifs, Fix imgur albums. Patch your **original** Sync APK together with the official **Spoof client** patch and its Reddit OAuth client ID; without it Sync cannot reach Reddit at all. The official Redgifs patch may stay selected: this bundle wraps the OkHttp client at a different point, so the two do not conflict.
